title: Vfs Table Selectable Without Navigate
description: Virtual file system table must have selectable file nodes. In sketchpad, clicking a row directly navigates — this must not happen on click; selection only.
summary:
VFS table: single click selects, double-click navigates.

- VirtualFileSystem: onRowDoubleClick prop forwarded to Table; expand chevron stops double-click propagation.
- Platform BuiltinVirtualFileSystemKindRenderer: onRowDoubleClick calls platform.onNavigate(row.navigateUri).
- Sketchpad E2E: design/type rows assert single-click selection and double-click navigation.

Tests: @ui/react 96 passed.
